title: How a Godly Man Leads a Family He Doesn't Have Yet
caption:
A godly man leads before he has anyone to lead.

The family you might have one day is being rehearsed right now, in how you get up, how you treat your parents, what you'll pay for, and how fast you say sorry. Nobody hands you leadership at the altar. You either built it or you didn't.

Which one of these four is the weakest for you this week? Start there.

#faith #godlymen #christianman #leadership #manofgod #futurehusband
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
